cases.sentence: Мой ___ не делает ничего, не рассказав мне об этом.
cases.translation: My father does nothing without telling me about it.
cases.explain: Отец is the grammatical subject of делает, so it takes nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я видел любовь моего ___ ко мне, и теперь я вижу его замысел.
cases.translation: I saw my father's love for me, and now I see his plot.
cases.explain: The genitive here shows possession - 'my father's love' requires the genitive case.

cases.translation: Please show kindness to your son.
cases.explain: The dative case shows the indirect object after the verb показать (to show).

cases.sentence: Я видел ___ в городе и понял все.
cases.translation: I saw the king in the city and understood everything.
cases.explain: The accusative case marks the direct object of the transitive verb видел.

cases.sentence: Иоаннафан вышел в поле, чтобы встретиться со своим ___.
cases.translation: Jonathan went to the field to meet with his friend.
cases.explain: The preposition со (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: На полу лежало ___ из драгоценного камня.
cases.translation: A precious stone lay on the floor.
cases.explain: Место is the subject of the verb лежало, requiring nominative case.

cases.sentence: Давид спрашивал его о том, как дела его ___.
cases.translation: David asked him how his family was.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession - 'his family' requires genitive after the possessive adjective.

cases.translation: Three arrows were shot near the stone pile.
cases.explain: The genitive case after the preposition около (near) shows location.

reading.question: What happens between David and Jonathan in this chapter?
reading.explain: The passage opens with 'Давид и Иоаннафан заключают союз' — David and Jonathan make a covenant.

reading.ru: Иоаннафан сказал Давиду, «Я сделаю для тебя все, что ты хочешь».
reading.question: What does Jonathan promise to do for David?
options: He will do anything David wants
He will speak to his father
He will give David his sword
reading.correct: He will do anything David wants
reading.explain: Jonathan says: 'Я сделаю для тебя все, что ты хочешь' — I will do for you anything you wish.

reading.ru: Давид ответил, «Завтра праздник Новолуния, и я должен обедать вместе с царем».
reading.question: What event occurs tomorrow according to David?
reading.explain: David says: 'Завтра праздник Новолуния' — Tomorrow is the new moon feast.

reading.ru: Мне остался один шаг до смерти.
reading.question: What does David mean by this statement?
reading.explain: The statement 'Мне остался один шаг до смерти' — There is but a step between me and death — means he is in mortal danger from Saul.

reading.ru: Иоаннафан пошлет мальчика, и если он скажет «Стрелы позади тебя», то приходи.
reading.question: What signal from Jonathan means David should come out of hiding?
options: The arrows are ahead of you
reading.explain: Jonathan sets up this signal: if he says 'Стрелы позади тебя' (arrows behind you), it means the coast is clear.

reading.ru: Затем они поцеловали друг друга и вместе заплакали, но Давид плакал больше.
reading.question: How do David and Jonathan part?
options: They kiss and weep, with David weeping more
reading.correct: They kiss and weep, with David weeping more
reading.explain: The text states: 'Затем они поцеловали друг друга и вместе заплакали, но Давид плакал больше' — They kissed and wept together, but David wept more.
